newsitem.title: USA: Trans-World says Russian investments still on.
newsitem.headline: Trans-World says Russian investments still on.

text.p: Trans-World Group said its plan to invest half a billion dollars in two Russian aluminum smelters will proceed as intended.
"It's still full steam ahead with investments in Bratsk and Sayansk," a spokeswoman for the company said.

Last Wednesday Trans-World's executive chairman, David Reuben, said the company was investing $500 million to upgrade and expand output at the Bratsk and Sayansk aluminum smelters in which it has minority stakes.
Some confusion arose due to subsequent reports which suggested Trans-World was putting on hold the investment until comments by Russia's Interior Minister, Anatoly Kulikov were clarified.

Kulikov suggested to the Duma parliament on February 21 that Russian smelters needed protecting from Western companies which tolled alumina in Russia, and suggested import duties should also be slapped on raw materials used to make aluminum.
Trans-World is a major toller of alumina in Russia.
